items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: Helen -- I think she sounded good with the band. I think she fit with the band

ctx.x: You know? And, when I walked in I saw alot of people. But then I saw her -- I saw Helen. And she was so busy, and looked so happy, and so friendly, you know what I mean, that she really made an impression on me.
That's when I really met her, too.
